control_implications.significance: CISA KEV inclusion confirms active exploitation, requiring immediate asset identification and remediation verification. Vulnerability and asset owners must confirm affected deployments and validate patch deployment or compensating controls.

Paint gets this fix only through a Store update, not through Windows updates. The fixed build, 11.2609.401.0, was the newest Paint build in all ten countries The Hacker News checked today.
control_implications.headline: Microsoft Paint RCE fix delivered exclusively via Microsoft Store
control_implications.significance: Remediation bypasses standard Windows Update channels, creating a coverage gap in standard patch management. Change and service owners must verify Store update deployment across endpoints and validate version compliance.

paragraphs.text: CISA added a SonicWall SonicOS authentication bypass to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog amid reports of real-world exploitation, while OpenSSH SSHole flaw saw active exploitation within hours of disclosure. These developments confirm that high-severity vulnerabilities in widely deployed network and system software are being weaponized immediately, demanding accelerated asset identification, configuration validation, and remediation verification across vulnerability management programs.

Multiple supply chain and identity provider failures emerged: default administrative credentials on the ForgeRock identity platform enabled vehicle account takeover, a Web3Auth flaw compromised cryptocurrency wallets, a third-party cloud service breach exposed 7.7 million personal records, and a service provider compromise facilitated a $133 million bank heist. Concurrently, AI agents were used to extract government emergency dispatch records. These events collectively elevate third-party risk, access management, and incident response priorities for control owners.
